site_wide_scan_2026_09_15.scope: Every article (272), product (1,449) and page (419) in the store was pulled and scanned. Previously only articles had been checked.
site_wide_scan_2026_09_15.headline: The absolute-URL defect is site-wide, and pages are by far the worst affected: 5,467 absolute internal links across 366 pages, vs 1,857 across products and 886 across articles.
site_wide_scan_2026_09_15.CORRECTION: An earlier count in this file said 326 products were defective. 115 of those only carried target=_blank on EXTERNAL links (Google review, Trustpilot, Drinkaware), which is correct behaviour and is left alone. The real product remediation set is 211.
site_wide_scan_2026_09_15.bulk_path: bulkOperationRunMutation is still blocked by the MCP safety policy (re-tested 2026-09-15). Every resource must be written individually, so the full set is shipped as CSVs under seo/internal-links/bulk/ for a bulk-import app or a script with Admin API access.
site_wide_scan_2026_09_15.template_evidence: 408 distinct internal targets across the 419 pages, but the same handful dominate: /collections/alcohol-gift-sets appears as an absolute link on 229 pages, /collections/champagne on 220, /collections/wines on 152. This is bulk-generated content, which is why a bulk edit is the right remediation.

jsonld_price_audit_2026_09_15.finding: 186 products hard-code a price inside their own Product JSON-LD. 27 of those disagree with the live variant price.
jsonld_price_audit_2026_09_15.risk: Google can read the wrong price into rich results. 11 of the 27 advertise a price LOWER than the store actually charges, which is the riskier direction.
jsonld_price_audit_2026_09_15.root_cause: The price is written into the description HTML by hand, so it goes stale whenever the variant price changes. Correcting the 27 values is a patch, not a fix - the durable fix is to drop the offers block from the hand-written JSON-LD and let the theme emit Product schema from the live price. That could not be verified from here because storefront requests are blocked, so it is left as a recommendation.

stopping_point_rationale.why_stop_here: The three largest remaining articles (flower-champagne 428, alcohol-for-party 218, delivery-service 46) are ENGLISH-ONLY and each has www_ld=0. Neither of the two justifications for this work applies to them: there is no locale to break, and no wrong canonical host to correct. The only residual benefit is stripping target=_blank and tidying absolute->relative, against ~20k tokens and real transcription risk per article (bodies are 22-31KB). That is a poor trade.
stopping_point_rationale.verified_clean: easy-cocktail-recipes (145 sessions, ar+zh) was checked and carries zero defects already - no work needed.
stopping_point_rationale.known_gap: Only ARTICLES were scanned for defects (272 of them). The 418 PAGES were not swept wholesale - 4 were fixed opportunistically. One zh page (food-pairings-with-every-champagne, 40 sessions) and several en pages still carry unknown defect counts. A page sweep is the logical next step if this continues.
